name: mdbook-docs
title: mdBook docs
blurb: mdBook docs: a real book whose links and table of contents are checked in CI — a shell link checker with a tested exit-code contract, and a suite that proves it catches broken links, missing images and orphan pages

verify.name: build
verify.cmd: make -s build && test -f book/index.html && test -f book/guide/writing.html

verify.name: broken-link
verify.cmd:
set +e
work=$(mktemp -d)
cp -r book.toml src tools "$work/"
printf '\n[gone](nowhere.md)\n' >> "$work/src/index.md"
out=$(./tools/check-links.sh "$work" 2>&1)
status=$?
printf '%s\n' "$out"
rm -rf "$work"
test "$status" -eq 1
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'nowhere.md does not exist'
